Definition
[Type A singular solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0154, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0155 1. ch30:30.1\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

A finite-time singular Ricci flow $(\mathcal M^n,g(t))$, $t\in (\alpha ,\omega )$, is Type A if there are $M<\infty $ and $r\in [1,3/2)$ such that \[ |\Rm |(x,t)\leq \frac{M}{(\omega -t)^r} \qquad \text{on }\mathcal M\times (\alpha ,\omega ). \] The case $r=1$ is the Type I condition.
